{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Finset.sup_image₂_le",
      "informal_name": "Supremum of Binary Image Bounded iff Elements Bounded",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {δ : Type u_7} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {f : α → β → γ} {s : Finset α}\n  {t : Finset β} [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup δ] [inst_2 : OrderBot δ] {g : γ → δ} {a : δ},\n  (Finset.image₂ f s t).sup g ≤ a ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, g (f x y) ≤ a",
      "informal_description": "For any function $ g : \\gamma \\to \\delta $ and any $ a \\in \\delta $, the supremum of $ g $ over the image set $ \\{ f(x, y) \\mid x \\in s, y \\in t \\} $ satisfies $ \\sup_{z \\in \\text{image}_2(f,s,t)} g(z) \\leq a $ if and only if $ g(f(x, y)) \\leq a $ for all $ x \\in s $ and $ y \\in t $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Finset.NAry"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finset.sup'_image₂_le",
      "informal_name": "Supremum of Binary Image Bounded Above iff All Elements Bounded Above",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {δ : Type u_7} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {f : α → β → γ} {s : Finset α}\n  {t : Finset β} [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup δ] {g : γ → δ} {a : δ} (h : (Finset.image₂ f s t).Nonempty),\n  (Finset.image₂ f s t).sup' h g ≤ a ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, g (f x y) ≤ a",
      "informal_description": "The supremum of $ g $ applied to the image of a binary function $ f $ over finite sets $ s $ and $ t $ is less than or equal to $ a $ if and only if for all $ x \\in s $ and $ y \\in t $, $ g(f(x, y)) \\leq a $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Finset.NAry"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finset.sup_image₂_right",
      "informal_name": "Supremum over Binary Image as Nested Suprema (Right)",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {δ : Type u_7} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {f : α → β → γ} (s : Finset α)\n  (t : Finset β) [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup δ] [inst_2 : OrderBot δ] (g : γ → δ),\n  (Finset.image₂ f s t).sup g = t.sup fun y => s.sup fun x => g (f x y)",
      "informal_description": "For a binary function $ f : \\alpha \\to \\beta \\to \\gamma $, finite sets $ s \\subseteq \\alpha $ and $ t \\subseteq \\beta $, and a function $ g : \\gamma \\to \\delta $ where $ \\delta $ is a sup-semilattice with bottom element, the supremum of $ g $ applied to the image of $ f $ over $ s \\times t $ satisfies $ \\sup_{(x,y) \\in s \\times t} g(f(x,y)) = \\sup_{x \\in s} \\left( \\sup_{y \\in t} g(f(x,y)) \\right) $. This expresses that the supremum over the binary image can be computed by first taking suprema over $ t $ for each $ x \\in s $, then taking the supremum over $ s $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Finset.NAry"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "iSup_image2",
      "informal_name": "Supremum of Image of Binary Function Equals Double Supremum",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : CompleteLattice α] {γ : Type u_8} {δ : Type u_9} (f : β → γ → δ) (s : Set β)\n  (t : Set γ) (g : δ → α), ⨆ d ∈ Set.image2 f s t, g d = ⨆ b ∈ s, ⨆ c ∈ t, g (f b c)",
      "informal_description": "Let $\\alpha$ be a complete lattice, $f : \\beta \\to \\gamma \\to \\delta$ a binary function, $s \\subseteq \\beta$, $t \\subseteq \\gamma$, and $g : \\delta \\to \\alpha$. Then the supremum of $g(d)$ over all $d$ in the image of $f$ on $s \\times t$ equals the double supremum of $g(f(b,c))$ over all $b \\in s$ and $c \\in t$. Formally: $\\sup_{d \\in \\mathrm{image}_2(f,s,t)} g(d) = \\sup_{b \\in s} \\sup_{c \\in t} g(f(b,c))$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Order.CompleteLattice.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finset.sup_image₂_left",
      "informal_name": "Supremum over Binary Image Equals Nested Suprema",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {δ : Type u_7} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {f : α → β → γ} (s : Finset α)\n  (t : Finset β) [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup δ] [inst_2 : OrderBot δ] (g : γ → δ),\n  (Finset.image₂ f s t).sup g = s.sup fun x => t.sup fun x_1 => g (f x x_1)",
      "informal_description": "The supremum of $ g $ over the image of the binary function $ f $ applied to finite sets $ s $ and $ t $ is equal to the supremum over $ s $ of the supremum over $ t $ of $ g(f(x, y)) $.",

items.informal_name: Supremum of Binary Image Bounded iff Elements Bounded
items.informal_description: For any function $ g : \gamma \to \delta $ and any $ a \in \delta $, the supremum of $ g $ over the image set $ \{ f(x, y) \mid x \in s, y \in t \} $ satisfies $ \sup_{z \in \text{image}_2(f,s,t)} g(z) \leq a $ if and only if $ g(f(x, y)) \leq a $ for all $ x \in s $ and $ y \in t $.

items.informal_name: Supremum of Binary Image Bounded Above iff All Elements Bounded Above
items.informal_description: The supremum of $ g $ applied to the image of a binary function $ f $ over finite sets $ s $ and $ t $ is less than or equal to $ a $ if and only if for all $ x \in s $ and $ y \in t $, $ g(f(x, y)) \leq a $.

items.informal_name: Supremum over Binary Image as Nested Suprema (Right)
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {δ : Type u_7} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {f : α → β → γ} (s : Finset α)
  (t : Finset β) [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup δ] [inst_2 : OrderBot δ] (g : γ → δ),
  (Finset.image₂ f s t).sup g = t.sup fun y => s.sup fun x => g (f x y)
items.informal_description: For a binary function $ f : \alpha \to \beta \to \gamma $, finite sets $ s \subseteq \alpha $ and $ t \subseteq \beta $, and a function $ g : \gamma \to \delta $ where $ \delta $ is a sup-semilattice with bottom element, the supremum of $ g $ applied to the image of $ f $ over $ s \times t $ satisfies $ \sup_{(x,y) \in s \times t} g(f(x,y)) = \sup_{x \in s} \left( \sup_{y \in t} g(f(x,y)) \right) $. This expresses that the supremum over the binary image can be computed by first taking suprema over $ t $ for each $ x \in s $, then taking the supremum over $ s $.

items.informal_name: Supremum of Image of Binary Function Equals Double Supremum
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : CompleteLattice α] {γ : Type u_8} {δ : Type u_9} (f : β → γ → δ) (s : Set β)
  (t : Set γ) (g : δ → α), ⨆ d ∈ Set.image2 f s t, g d = ⨆ b ∈ s, ⨆ c ∈ t, g (f b c)
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ be a complete lattice, $f : \beta \to \gamma \to \delta$ a binary function, $s \subseteq \beta$, $t \subseteq \gamma$, and $g : \delta \to \alpha$. Then the supremum of $g(d)$ over all $d$ in the image of $f$ on $s \times t$ equals the double supremum of $g(f(b,c))$ over all $b \in s$ and $c \in t$. Formally: $\sup_{d \in \mathrm{image}_2(f,s,t)} g(d) = \sup_{b \in s} \sup_{c \in t} g(f(b,c))$.

items.informal_name: Supremum over Binary Image Equals Nested Suprema
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_3} {γ : Type u_5} {δ : Type u_7} [inst : DecidableEq γ] {f : α → β → γ} (s : Finset α)
  (t : Finset β) [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup δ] [inst_2 : OrderBot δ] (g : γ → δ),
  (Finset.image₂ f s t).sup g = s.sup fun x => t.sup fun x_1 => g (f x x_1)
items.informal_description: The supremum of $ g $ over the image of the binary function $ f $ applied to finite sets $ s $ and $ t $ is equal to the supremum over $ s $ of the supremum over $ t $ of $ g(f(x, y)) $.
